newsitem.title: UK: UK Japan shares off, derivatives take centre stage.
newsitem.headline: UK Japan shares off, derivatives take centre stage.

text.p: Japanese shares posted small losses on Wednesday as the market's attention shifted to derivatives, dealers said.
The Nikkei was 0.81 points off at 1,507.97.
"Sentiment is still basically good and most people think the market's going to push ahead but there's very little outright stock business," said one dealer.
Players preferred to buy derivatives - mostly warrants - to get a leveraged play on stock, dealers said.
"People are particularly interested in the high tech and blue chip stocks," said another dealer.
